[Intro]
[Verse]
Dust hung heavy on the broken plow
The sun carved lines upon his brow
A lifetime earned in the heavy clay
He worked the ground through every day

Hold the line and stand your ground
Where the roots are deep and truth is found
Let the wind carry the secrets told

[Bridge]
One step forward, a thousand miles
Finding the grace in the dusty miles
[Chorus]
Hold the line and stand your ground
Where the roots are deep and truth is found
Let the wind carry the secrets told
Turn the iron into honest gold
[Outro]
